budgets.area: landing supervisor: check result to commit
budgets.source: Issue 03a749a5 (folded into b7851c44): the gap from check result (ciEndedAt) to the landing commit (committedAt) was 300 s before fix caa934a7 and measured 8.5 s live after it; stamped on every landing.

budgets.area: unsaved-work snapshot: added to a Forge command, no changed file
budgets.source: Issue 7ac4e32f part 2, 2026-11-10, a hosted Lane checkout of a fresh import of this repo (4,210 files) on the dev deployment. Launching the snapshot worker inside a real CLI command added p50 2.4 ms, p90 5.9 ms, max 11 ms (25 commands); node scripts/perf-harness.mjs --snapshot-lane measured p50 1.1 ms, p90 1.5 ms (25 launches). Before, when the snapshot ran in the command's process, the walk of the same tree took p50 129 ms, p90 144 ms warm (138 ms in a fresh process), which is why the work moved to a detached worker.
budgets.reason: The lead's bar: single-op parity with git, so a command with nothing to snapshot adds under 50 ms. Judged on the p90 of the harness samples. The worker's own time (about 0.8 s of CPU per launch, at most one per 3 seconds per Lane) is background cost, not command latency.

budgets.area: unsaved-work snapshot: added to a Forge command, one or fifty changed files
budgets.source: Same checkout. Launching the worker with one changed file inside a real CLI command added p50 3.1 ms, p90 12.1 ms (max 26); with fifty changed files p50 4.2 ms, p90 16.2 ms (max 62); 25 commands each. perf-harness --snapshot-lane, one and fifty files together: p50 1.5 ms, p90 6.9 ms (50 launches). The snapshot is durable about 1.0 s (one file) and 1.9 s (fifty) after the command ends. Before, in the command's process: one file p50 808 ms, p90 920 ms; fifty files p50 1,665 ms, p90 1,818 ms.
budgets.reason: The lead's bar: a changed snapshot must not block a command for more than 300 ms at p90. Set to that bar, not to the measured numbers, because the cost is a process spawn and moves with machine load.

costGuard.scenario: Six accepted-Candidate landings: solo, main moved during the check (source-job recompose and re-check), and a batch of four. Includes dependency-aware client observer reads. Save/initial compose, real CI ingest and GitHub mirror are outside this mix; a separate twelve-shard CI ingest guard covers inline logs, reports, retries and provider conclusion. Action GB-seconds use nominal durations, not live wall time. A separate github-inbound-fixture measures one 24-byte GitHub main push through real import, compose, desired landing, acceptance and mirror drain; bootstrap and real CI excluded.

costs.area: GitHub Actions wall minutes of a landing's checks (latency, not runner minutes)
costs.source: Dogfood main 2026-11-08 to 11-10: 421 distinct check runs for 285 accepted landings (1.48 per landing, landings read) times the check p50 of 8.3 min (speed budget check-p50). This is wall time, one run's shards running side by side: the runner minutes behind it are the next entry (capture #4: stored shard seconds 77.9 min per landing, mostly 12 shards of about 4.5 min each per run).
costs.reason: Kept for the queue-throughput and latency decisions; judged live by check-p50/p90 and attempts, and on change by landing-check-runs. Do not read it as cost: price follows check-runner-minutes.

costs.area: GitHub Actions runner minutes of a landing's checks (shard execution, summed over shards)
costs.source: Check results of the 36 landings that settled 2026-11-10 04:06Z to 08:31Z (landings read, then the stored run summary of each run: timings.executionSeconds, the shard execution seconds the run row keeps). Per landing: accepted check 54.4 min (rolling 20-landing mean 49.2 to 57.0, 10 to 12 shards, one scoped run of 2), runs its attempts discarded 4.7 (2.5 to 5.9), the main audit that followed 18.8 (13.3 to 23.4; 12 audit runs shared by 36 landings, counted once). Live since this change: budgets landing-runner-accepted-mean, landing-runner-discarded-mean and landing-runner-audit-mean.
costs.reason: Capture #4 measured about 113 GitHub runner minutes per landing (1,110 exact by job interval in a 56.9 min window with 10 landings; $0 billed on our public repository, about $681 per 1,000 landings at list price for a private repository). Of those, 86.4 are the forge-check runs (accepted 53.8, discarded 5.5, audit 11.4, check-only and cancelled runs that never became a landing 15.7), 22.0 are this repository's own Verify Forge workflow on each push (not a user's check), 2.6 deploy, sign and smoke. The stored shard seconds (77.9, a 36-landing window) are about 90% of the forge-check minutes (86.4, a 10-landing window); the rest is the plan and static jobs, setup before the shards and runs no landing owns.

costs.source: tests/hosted-agent-planning.test.mjs on the in-process Convex fixture, 2026-11-10: one CLI planning search and one new Issue (its likelyDuplicates check) each run one withSearchIndex query; ordinary rows add no per-result search.

costs.area: Billed search bytes (query-GB) per search_planning query on dogfood
costs.source: convex logs --success sample, 2026-11-10 (Issue a02991a7): textIndexQueryBytes 7.47 MB for every projectHostedPlanningSearch:search, projectHostedFriction:capture and projectWorkIndex:workspace search. Convex docs (search/text-search#costs) and convex-backend usage_tracking: each query counts the full on-disk size of the index, once per search.
costs.reason: Billed as Search queries at $0.11 per 1,000 query-GB (Starter), about $0.0000008 per search and $0.0008 a day at 920 searches; it grows with every projectWorkRecords row of every generation, not with the limit. Judged on change by planning-index-searches.

costs.area: Save-time trial merge: full overlap-row reads for a truncated disjoint peer, per save
costs.source: tests/hosted-trial-merge.test.mjs: a 40-path disjoint peer reads zero full overlap rows; legacy rows without the optional filter stay conservative, and an omitted shared path still gets the same trial merge. Synthetic DB bytes are metered, not billed usage.
costs.reason: Replaces unconditional full-row reads for truncated peers with a 512-character all-path filter. At the capture #4 mix (60,000 old peer bytes/save, 1.6 head moves/landing), 1,000 landings avoid 96 MB of peer rows before false positives and rollout. At a full 51-row presence window the added field costs at most about 27 KB/save, leaving about 53 MB net read savings/1,000 landings; shared peers, false positives, writes and other presence reads reduce the net. Calls unchanged; idle zero.

costs.area: Batched CI result collection, independent provider verdict and timing aggregation per check run
costs.source: tests/hosted-actions-result-growth.test.mjs: interleaved 12-shard, 886-file CI result fixture, including provider conclusion and deferred timing aggregation; one check run per fixture landing.
costs.reason: One batch replaces per-shard run/progress rewrites; terminal reports are paged outside the head, and CI replies are minimal. R2 inbox PUT/LIST/GET operations replace larger repeated Convex I/O; scratch is removed after ingest. Calls are not priced in the Professional model.
